exceptions.runtimeReachability: The CRM loads Firestore through @google-cloud/firestore. google-gax@5.0.8 declares rimraf@5.0.10, but the shipped google-gax JavaScript package does not import or execute rimraf; rimraf is a file-removal helper and the vulnerable brace-expansion path is not reachable from CRM request handling.
exceptions.rationale: No supported Firestore 8.x release removes google-gax@5.0.8's unused rimraf declaration; Firestore 7.x reintroduces direct moderate Firestore and UUID advisories. Downgrades and cross-major overrides were tested and rejected. Remove this exception as soon as Google publishes a compatible Firestore/google-gax release without the rimraf@5 chain, or replace the repository adapter before the expiry.
